integrity: Original all-dimensional claim is proved analytically; finite exact-rational tests are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The numerical index follows from earlier general principles and is not independently novel. No general code-polytope result, no independent validation, no exhaustive historical-priority certification.
scientific_scope: All Euclidean-nearest vertices give optimal exact Minkowski decomposition of points in even-parity demihypercubes for n>=4; a linear-time selection rule.
title: A linear-time nearest-vertex covering certificate for every demihypercube
